description: This file defines the HolidayServiceCachingProxy class which manages holiday data caching, fetching holiday information from Google Calendar API, and interacting with a repository for storage. It includes methods for cache validation, refresh, and retrieval of holiday data within date ranges.

classes.name: HolidayServiceCachingProxy
classes.description: A proxy class that manages cached holiday data, interacts with Google Calendar API, and updates the cache as needed.

methods.name: isCacheStale
methods.description: Checks if the cached holiday data for a specific country and year is outdated based on the cache duration.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Fetches latest holiday data from Google Calendar API and updates the cache repository.

methods.name: getHolidaysForCountry
methods.description: Retrieves holiday data for a specific country and year, refreshing cache if stale.

methods.name: getHolidaysInRange
methods.description: Retrieves holiday data within a date range, refreshing cache for each year if stale.
